item.title: After dreaming about it for years, Nolan Ames is Mr. Maine Basketball
item.description: The talented Camden Hills High School guard was named the recipient of the Mr. Maine Basketball Award on Friday.

item.title: Searsport voters approve mobile home rent stabilization measure
item.description: The rent stabilization measure, which passed 67-12 at the annual town meeting, will apply to all three of the town’s mobile home parks.

item.title: Watch Cooper Flagg describe the ‘incredible’ energy at his Boston homecoming
item.description: Watch Cooper Flagg's postgame press conference after his first NBA game at the TD Garden in Boston as the Mavericks faced the Celtics.

item.title: UMaine basketball ends season with loss to NJIT
item.description: The University of Maine basketball team concluded its season with a 60-58 defeat against #3 NJIT, ending with an 8-24 record.

item.title: Black Bears fall to last-place Vermont, retain fifth seed in Hockey East
item.description: The University of Maine’s hockey team secured the fifth seed for the Hockey East Tournament and will face Boston College in the quarterfinals, despite a 5-3 loss to Vermont in its regular season finale.

item.title: I discovered this epic 12-mile ski loop in Acadia National Park
item.description: Around-the-Mountain is one of several circuits in Acadia's winter carriage road system, which totals about 30 miles of cross-country skiing.

item.title: Aroostook developer turns an old school into a 4-season retreat
item.description: The Old School Plaza in Monticello includes a laundromat, grocery store, barber shop, storage units, taxi service and a camping area with more to come.

item.title: Coastal Maine boatyard gets $1.5M to expand further into new technology
item.description: With a new 7,520-square foot building at its headquarters, the boatyard will have room for more building, restoration and service projects.
